paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Domain distribution of our annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set (covering 12 domains in total).
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set, which encompasses a total of 12 distinct domains. The largest segment, representing 24.3% of the dataset, is labeled "AI/NLP Research" and is colored blue. The second largest segment, at 18.4%, is "Econ. & Fin." and is depicted in teal. Other notable categories include "Game&Anime" at 8.2% (orange), "History" at 8.2% (yellow), and "Med & Health" at 6.7% (light green), which shares the same percentage as "Science" (light blue). Smaller segments include "Daily Life" (7.1%, light cyan), "Pet & Animal" (5.5%, dark green), "Law" (5.1%, red), "Business" (5.9%, dark red), "Geography" (2.7%, dark yellow), and "Math" (1.2%, very dark green). Each slice is clearly labeled with its corresponding domain name and percentage, and the chart uses a variety of distinct colors to differentiate the categories, with the largest slices appearing to be slightly pulled out for emphasis.
